name: robot-preview-urdf-mjcf
description: Live 3D viewer for URDF, Xacro and MJCF robot models (ROS, ROS 2, MuJoCo) inside VS Code

robotPreviewUrdf.autoOpen.description: Open the preview beside the editor when a URDF, Xacro or MJCF file becomes active.

enumDescriptions: Rebuild the preview 300 ms after typing stops, including unsaved edits, like the Markdown preview.
Rebuild the preview only when a file is saved.
robotPreviewUrdf.updateOn.description: When the preview picks up edits made in VS Code. Changes made outside VS Code always update immediately.

robotPreviewUrdf.packages.markdownDescription: Package name to folder, for `package://` and `$(find)` packages without a `package.xml` in the workspace or a sourced ROS environment. Takes priority over automatic discovery. Supports `${workspaceFolder}`, `${workspaceFolder:name}`, `${env:VAR}` and `~`; relative paths start at the first workspace folder.

robotPreviewUrdf.packageSearchPaths.markdownDescription: Folders searched for ROS packages at any depth, as colcon does (`COLCON_IGNORE` and `AMENT_IGNORE` are honoured), for another workspace's `src` or an install outside `AMENT_PREFIX_PATH` such as a pixi environment's `share`. Searched after the workspace, before the ROS environment. Supports the same variables as `robotPreviewUrdf.packages`.

enumDescriptions: A joint names a link that does not exist (error).
A link is the child of more than one joint (error).
Joints form a loop instead of a tree (error).
Two links or two joints share a name (error).
More than one link has no parent (error).
A revolute or prismatic joint has no <limit>, or a <limit> lacks effort or velocity (error).
An <inertial> has no <mass> (error).
A non-root link with geometry has no <inertial>.
A link has a mass of zero or less.
An inertia is not positive definite or breaks the triangle inequality.
A moving joint has a zero axis.
A joint limit has lower > upper.
A joint limit has zero effort or velocity.
A continuous joint sets lower/upper, which are ignored.
Visual and collision sizes differ 100x or more (likely mm vs m).
An element ROS does not read where it is written, such as a typo or an <origin> directly in a <link>.
An attribute the element does not have, or one its URDF version does not read.
An element lacks an attribute ROS requires, such as <box> without size (error unless only a colour is lost).
An element lacks a child ROS requires, such as a <visual> without <geometry> or an <inertial> without <inertia> (error).
A value that is not a number, has the wrong count of numbers, or is not a joint type (error unless only a colour is lost).
The first element in <geometry> is not a shape, or is a <capsule> below URDF 1.1 (error).

robotPreviewUrdf.checks.disabled.markdownDescription: Model and structure checks to skip. Each Problems entry shows its rule id as the code.
